entities.summary: Elizabeth Olatayo Williams is a Nigerian-American professional basketball player for the Chicago Sky of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Galatasaray of the Turkish Super League. She played college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils. She was drafted by the Connecticut Sun 4th overall in the 2015 WNBA draft.
